definitions.explanation: The current era or contemporary period.

examples.japanese: {現代|げんだい}⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧
{現代|げんだい}⟦{人|じん}→〜人：09849_jin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧

{現代|げんだい}⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦テクノロジー→テクノロジー：11587_tekunorojii⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦あらゆる→あらゆる：03824_arayuru⟧⟦{場面|ばめん}→場面：03702_bamen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{与|あた}えている→与える：01821_ataeru⟧。
examples.english: In modern society, technology affects every aspect of life.

notes:
{現代|げんだい} means the current era or contemporary period. It can function as a noun or as a prefix modifying other nouns.

COMPOUNDS:
- {現代|げんだい}⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧: modern, contemporary (na-adjective)
- {現代|げんだい}⟦{人|じん}→〜人：09849_jin⟧: modern person
- {現代|げんだい}⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧: modern society
- {現代|げんだい}⟦{文学|ぶんがく}→文学：01505_bungaku⟧: contemporary literature
- {現代|げんだい}⟦{語|ご}→〜語：09841_go⟧: modern language

JAPANESE HISTORICAL PERIODS:
- ⟦{古代|こだい}→古代：05324_kodai⟧: ancient times (before ~1185)
- ⟦{中世|ちゅうせい}→中世：05524_chuusei⟧: medieval period (~1185-1603)
- ⟦{近世|きんせい}→近世：14399_kinsei⟧: early modern period (~1603-1868)
- ⟦{近代|きんだい}→近代：02663_kindai⟧: modern era (~1868-1945)
- {現代|げんだい}: contemporary era (1945-present)

Note that both ⟦{近代|きんだい}→近代：02663_kindai⟧ and {現代|げんだい} translate as "modern" in English, but in Japanese historical usage they refer to different periods. ⟦{近代|きんだい}→近代：02663_kindai⟧ covers the Meiji through early Showa periods, while {現代|げんだい} refers to the postwar era onward.
